title: dust-forecast-error-vs-event-skill-kurdistan: analysis code for satellite-based error and observer-based event skill of day-ahead dust forecasts
description: Analysis code and data-download scripts for the article 'Satellite-Based Error and Observer-Based Event Skill Rank Day-Ahead Dust Hindcasts Differently over the Kurdistan Region and Mesopotamia'. Day-ahead forecasts of regional aerosol optical depth over 30-40 N, 38-50 E (2003-2024) are verified against the MODIS retrieval and against blowing dust reported by surface observers, with the event denominator restricted to stations that filed present-weather reports. No data are redistributed; all inputs are public.
